design.quote: An investigator-initiated, double-blinded, randomized, placebo-controlled, multicenter superiority trial [NCT05084235]

population.value: Older adult (60-84 years), overweight (BMI >28 kg/m2) individuals with at least 1 known risk factor for HF (hypertension, ischemic heart disease, stroke, chronic kidney disease); individuals with HF or type 2 diabetes were excluded
population.quote: comprised 191 older adult (60-84 years), overweight (body mass index [BMI] >28 kg/m2) individuals with at least 1 known risk factor for HF (hypertension, ischemic heart disease, stroke, chronic kidney disease)

sample_size.quote: Of the 191 randomized, 165 individuals (median age, 68 years; median BMI, 31.8 kg/m2; 67% were male; and median LVEF, 65%) completed MRI

intervention.quote: Study participants were randomized 1:1 to empagliflozin 10 mg or matching placebo for 180 days.

comparator.quote: Study participants were randomized 1:1 to empagliflozin 10 mg or matching placebo for 180 days.

follow_up.quote: Study participants were randomized 1:1 to empagliflozin 10 mg or matching placebo for 180 days.

primary_findings.quote: Empagliflozin reduced LVMI with an estimated treatment difference of -1.9 g/m2 (97.5% confidence interval [CI]: -3.5 to -0.2; P = .01).
primary_findings.outcome: Change in left ventricular mass index (LVMI)
